content.short: Fun.xyz provides funding rails for applications to optimise onboarding and reduce costs.
content.description: Fun.xyz is a checkout layer that takes whatever asset a user holds, on whatever chain, and delivers the token an application needs. The integrator sets the destination and Fun handles conversion, bridging and settlement behind a single flow. It is aimed at apps that would otherwise turn away users arriving with the wrong asset.
